text: During a round of layoffs at an August Alt Weekly, a copy editor turned cannibal and chewed off a recently fired editor's ear. See, you gotta watch those spaces before and after the M dashes or else. Update, turns out the copy editing cannibal is also a poet. Check out her poems after the jump.
